profile.headline: Front End Developer
profile.summary:
What's up! My name is Samuel Morales, but you can just call me Sam, and I'm a Web and Shopify Developer based in Salt Lake City, Utah. With a passion for UX design and front end development.

I'm here to help your business achieve and exceed it's goals and in order to thrive in the digital space. I would love to work with you to help create and design beautiful websites, and functional applications for all of your business needs.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
● Develop interactive and competent Online Shopify Stores for driving Sales and Revenue.
● Generate custom Shopify Themes and modify pre-existing templates based on defined brand benchmarks.
● Specialize in all facets of the ECommerce platform.
● Collaborate with the Art Production Team to develop exclusive, robust, and innovative front-end user
experiences.
● Ensure a seamless connection with Marketing Tools, Platform APIs, and Shopify Apps to optimize the
store for sheer performance and needed functionalities.
● Testing and Debugging of websites for better performance.
● Provide Technical Support and Coordination based on their findings, safeguarding businesses from failures.
● Optimizing websites for increased conversion rates.
● Perform other duties as assigned

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Specialize in Ecommerce Web Development, for more information check out www.moralessa.dev
• Create and manage front-end focused websites and applications. 
• Automated business processes 
• Offered technical support, involving front end technologies and Shopify as an Ecommerce platform

educations.fieldOfStudy: Web & User Experience : Emphasis on full stack development
